column3: “The beginning of Christ’s teaching” is rendered “the elementary teaching about the Christ,” and “go on” “press on.”
“Baptisms” is rendered “washings.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB restructures verses 4–6, placing “it is impossible” in verse 6.
“God’s declaration” is rendered “the good word of God,” and “power” “powers.”
NASB places “it is impossible” here and renders “restore” as “renew”; “crucifying” is rendered “since they again crucify.”
“Partakes of blessing” is rendered “receives a blessing.”
NASB renders the participle as a condition, “if it yields”; “near to a curse” is rendered “close to being cursed,” and “of which the end is unto burning” “it ends up being burned.”
“Persuaded” is rendered “convinced.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “labor” (“labor of love”).
“Earnestness” is rendered “diligence”; NASB adds “so as to realize.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB supplies “could” and “one.”
“Blessing I will bless … multiplying I will multiply” is rendered “I will surely bless … surely multiply.”
Close to the Greek.
NASB supplies “than themselves” and restructures the second clause.
“More excessive” is rendered “even more,” and “guaranteed” “interposed”; NASB adds “In the same way.”
NASB supplies “we who.”
NASB supplies “This hope” and “a hope”; “unshakable” is rendered “steadfast.”
“To the age” is rendered “forever.”
